items.title: Iranian minister says only negotiation can end conflict after Trump rejects Hormuz deal
items.description: The foreign minister says Tehran is waiting for an official rejection of a deal, despite the US President's comments.

items.title: Two mass shootings in South Africa leave 27 dead
items.description: The two attacks hours apart come as the country struggles to stop high levels of gang-related armed violence.

items.title: Embattled Serbian president resigns, paving way for early elections
items.description: Aleksandar Vučić's administration has been dogged by prolonged protests over allegations of corruption.

items.title: Two bodies found after avalanche hits Himalayan climbing group
items.description: Rescuers are looking for at least 10 Nepalese people who were preparing to take climbers up the Himlung Himal peak.

items.title: Four killed in helicopter crash near Montreal
items.description: The victims of the crash have not yet been identified, Quebec provincial police told the BBC.

items.title: One dead as nor'easter storm pummels New York and New Jersey
items.description: Tens of millions of people from Maine to Virginia found themselves in the path of the powerful weather system.

items.title: Venezuela releases dozens of political prisoners as election calls grow
items.description: A slew of dissidents being released from long-term detention comes days after the nation's interim leader met the US president.

items.title: Pope says 'scourge' of abuse must be rooted out as he visits Lourdes
items.description: Pope Leo spoke to bishops before leading a service attended by thousands of worshippers in France.

items.title: Killer Christa Pike to be executed within days - but her defence say she's a victim too
items.description: Lawyers for Pike, who killed a fellow student in 1995, say she should get clemency and would not be sentenced to death if the crime happened today.

items.title: Woman charged with stealing from patients and staff at hospitals across Ontario
items.description: The 34-year-old is under investigation for incidents that began in February 2024 up until as recently as last month.

items.title: Switzerland rejects stricter interpretation of its neutrality
items.description: The initiative would have prevented the nation from imposing sanctions unless approved by the UN.

items.title: German town bans 'stumbling stone' memorials to Nazi victims
items.description: Germany's education minister has branded the ban on the small brass memorial plaques a "scandal".
